mapper.insert: insert into withdraw_order (biz_order_id, to_address, amount, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{bizOrderId}, #{toAddress}, #{amount}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: update withdraw_order set status = #{status}, tx_hash = #{txHash}, update_time = NOW() where biz_order_id = #{bizOrderId}
mapper.select: select id, biz_order_id as bizOrderId, to_address as toAddress, amount, status, tx_hash as txHash, nonce, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from withdraw_order where biz_order_id = #{bizOrderId}
